name: Atomic and Molecular Physics
description: Hydrogen and alkali metals, double fine structure of atoms, magnetic moments of one to multi electron atoms, spin-orbit coupling, selection rules, Zeeman and Paschen-back effect, X-ray spectra, Fermi golden rule relating to experimental quantities of absorption spectra, transition probability, line intensities (spectral line broadening mechanisms, population of states, Beer-Lambert law), molecular symmetry, irreducible representations, rotational and vibrational spectra of diatomic molecules, FTIR and Raman spectroscopy, electronic spectroscopy, spectroscopic instrumentations, Franck-Condon principle, bond dissociation energies, photoluminescence spectroscopy, molecular orbital and models.
